chapter: Leo Watson and the Panassie sessions
title: Working with Pops Foster and Manzie Johnson
summary: Bunn played with Pops Foster four or five times and found him solid; he knew little about Manzie Johnson beyond being a good musician.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I see. I see. Did he get a lot of record dates, though, or --
No, he didn't get too many record dates.
No. This particular session you had, Pops Foster on the bass.
Now, you worked with him quite a bit, a lot of different sessions.
Well, I worked with him about four or five times.
Yeah. A lot of other different musicians.
Anybody that got the record date, I'd work with.
What was it like working with Pops?
Of course, a guitar and bass work very closely together.
Him and I got along very fine.
Not too -- it doesn't get too far away from --
Yeah. And then you -- in this particular session you were with Manzie Johnson.
Do you remember anything about him?
No, I don't know too much about Manzie. I know he's a good musician.
